territorial_scope.description: Applies nationally to social-network and private-messaging providers, and to foreign-seated providers that offer services to the Brazilian public or whose economic group has an establishment in Brazil.

evidence.quote: O disposto no caput aplica-se, inclusive, aos provedores de redes sociais

summary.short: Bill (PL 2630/2020) setting transparency, moderation and anti-inauthentic-account duties for social-network and private-messaging providers in Brazil, and creating a Transparency and Responsibility Council; most articles would apply 90 days after publication.
summary.long: Bill PL 2630/2020, the proposed Lei Brasileira de Liberdade, Responsabilidade e Transparência na Internet, applies to providers of social networks and private messaging services. Providers offering services to fewer than 2,000,000 registered Brazilian users are subject only to good-practice guidance. Foreign-seated providers are covered if they offer services to the Brazilian public or a group company has an establishment in Brazil. Providers must prohibit inauthentic accounts and unidentified automated accounts, label paid content, and disable group-inclusion by default in messaging services. Messaging services must keep mass-forwarding records for three months and must not allow external mass-messaging tools. Moderation requires notice, reasons and appeal, and providers must repair harm from wrongful content classification. Social networks must publish quarterly transparency reports within 30 days after each quarter and facilitate data sharing with academic researchers. Election-related advertising must be publicly available, and advertisers must confirm their identity. The bill creates a 21-member Council for Transparency and Responsibility on the Internet, which certifies self-regulatory bodies. Sanctions are a warning or a fine of up to 10% of the Brazilian economic group's revenue in its last fiscal year, with fines directed to Fundeb. The bill also amends the Marco Civil da Internet on six-month access-log retention. Council provisions take effect on publication; most other articles take effect 90 days after publication.

thresholds.value_text: menos de 2.000.000 (dois milhões) de usuários registrados
thresholds.measurement: Number of registered users of the provider's services offered to the Brazilian public; the text does not state a measurement window or method
thresholds.consequence: The Law does not apply to providers below the threshold; its provisions serve as a parameter for a good-practice programme on inauthentic behaviour and transparency of paid content.
thresholds.conditions: Provider of social networks or private messaging services offering services to the Brazilian public

evidence.quote: com menos de 2.000.000 (dois milhões) de usuários registrados

thresholds.variable_text: número de usuários que receberam a mesma mensagem por encaminhamento em massa
thresholds.value_text: mais de 5 (cinco) usuários, em intervalo de até 15 (quinze) dias
thresholds.measurement: Same message sent by more than 5 users within an interval of up to 15 days, to group chats, broadcast lists or similar multi-recipient mechanisms
thresholds.consequence: Such sending is defined as mass forwarding (encaminhamento em massa), to which the message-record duty of Art. 10 caput applies.
thresholds.conditions: Private messaging services; the 15-day window is stated in the same definition and is recorded here in measurement

evidence.quote: mais de 5 (cinco) usuários, em intervalo de até 15 (quinze) dias

thresholds.variable_text: total de usuários que receberam a mensagem
thresholds.measurement: Total number of users reached by the mass-forwarded message
thresholds.consequence: The duty to keep message records for 3 months under Art. 10 caput does not apply; records are to be destroyed under the LGPD.
thresholds.conditions: Applies to messages in mass forwarding as defined in Art. 10 § 1º

evidence.quote: não se aplica às mensagens que alcançarem quantitativo total inferior a 1.000 (mil) usuários

thresholds.variable_text: prazo para reincidência (repetição de conduta anteriormente sancionada)
thresholds.value_text: no prazo de 6 (seis) meses, condutas anteriormente sancionadas
thresholds.measurement: Period within which repetition of previously sanctioned conduct is counted as recidivism
thresholds.consequence: Repeat conduct within this period is recidivism, which the judicial authority considers when applying the sanction.
thresholds.conditions: Conduct previously sanctioned under this Law

evidence.quote: no prazo de 6 (seis) meses, condutas anteriormente sancionadas
